Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Financial Partnerships team at Airwallex is dedicated to building and managing strategic relationships with key financial institutions and fellow fintech partners worldwide. We focus on expanding Airwallex’s payment network, enhancing our product offerings, and driving mutual growth for Airwallex and our partners. We coordinate closely with cross-functional internal and external stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions and ensure our customers have access to the best financial services worldwide. Join a collaborative, high-impact team that values creativity, agility, and results.

What you'll do

As Senior Manager, Financial Partnerships, Card Issuing & Acquiring, EMEA, you’ll play a pivotal role in scaling Airwallex’s card issuing and acquiring businesses. You’ll be responsible for building and managing partnerships with global card networks (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, etc.) and regional/local card schemes, facilitating Airwallex’s entry into new markets, and unlocking strategic opportunities with our network partners. You’ll collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to deliver on critical initiatives and represent Airwallex at partner and industry events, helping to build our brand profile with partners and customers. This role is based in London.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage partnerships with global card networks and local card schemes to support Airwallex’s card issuing and acquiring businesses.

  • Facilitate Airwallex’s entry into new markets by coordinating network licensing, regulatory requirements, and program implementation.

  • Identify and execute on strategic opportunities with network partners, including product/feature collaboration, new revenue streams, cost optimization, and co-marketing initiatives, amongst others.

  • Negotiate and structure mutually beneficial partnership agreements, and oversee the execution of Airwallex’s obligations under these agreements.

  • Represent Airwallex at partner and industry events, actively building our brand profile with partners and customers.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Commercial) for strategic planning, execution of critical initiatives, business analysis, and communications regarding partnership status and strategy.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience working with payment networks, card schemes, financial institutions, or other players in the card issuing/acquiring industry.

  • Deep understanding of card network dynamics, issuing and acquiring business models, and economics.

  • Proven track record of building and managing strategic partnerships in a fast-paced, technology-led environment.

  • Strong negotiation, relationship management, and commercial agreement structuring skills.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial.

  • International experience—working in multiple markets or managing cross-border relationships.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills—able to connect with stakeholders at all levels and communicate project expectations and progress effectively.

  • Thrive under pressure—work well in a high-velocity environment with aggressive timelines, constant change, and dynamic priorities.

  • Creative problem-solving skills and innate curiosity—we’re trying to grow Airwallex exponentially by exploring new business constructs, not just replicating the old models employed by industry incumbents

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience at a global, high-growth fintech or pre-IPO startup.

  • Experience building financial partnerships in a new geography.

  • Experience with merchant acquiring and/or card portfolio management and optimizing pricing, interchange, and product profitability.

  • Recognized as an industry thought leader; experience representing your company at industry events.

This job description is designed to attract top-tier candidates by clearly outlining the impact, expectations, and growth opportunities of the role, while aligning with Airwallex’s internal standards and industry best practices.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Growth Manager, International (LATAM & EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the AI Risk Decisioning™ platform for banks and fintechs.

Our platform enables financial institutions to manage fraud, credit risk, compliance, and onboarding decisions in real time using modern AI infrastructure.

We work with leading fintechs and financial institutions and are backed by world-class investors. Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent.

We are building a category-defining company — and our GTM engine will be a core competitive advantage.

The Role

We are hiring a Founding Growth Manager, International (LATAM & EMEA) to launch Oscilar’s presence across Latin America and EMEA from zero.

Your job is to build the regional growth engine end-to-end: outbound campaigns, paid acquisition, regional events and webinars, and local partnerships — whatever it takes to generate pipeline in markets where we have no existing footprint.

This role is for a marketer who can operate independently in new markets, adapt messaging for local audiences, and move fast without a playbook. You’ll be sourcing leads, launching campaigns, and running events within your first weeks — not waiting for a strategy deck to be approved.

This is a high-ownership, 0-to-1 role with direct impact on Oscilar’s international expansion. You will be the first marketing hire dedicated to these regions.

You will work closely with our Head of Growth, VP of Marketing, and regional Sales leadership.

Location: EMEA or LATAM required.

Language: Fluent in English. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. Additional languages are a plus.

What You’ll Own

You will plan and execute the full regional growth marketing playbook across LATAM and EMEA, including:

Outbound Campaigns

  • Build and run multi-touch outbound sequences targeting regional prospects using Clay, Outreach, HeyReach, Nooks, and Cargo

  • Localize messaging and campaign assets for regional audiences — tone, language, compliance nuances

  • Design segmented plays by market, persona, and account tier

  • Partner with BDRs on regional outbound strategy and follow-up workflows

Paid Acquisition

  • Launch and manage paid campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads, and relevant regional platforms

  • Own regional ad creative, landing pages (Framer or equivalent), targeting, and budget allocation

  • Run continuous A/B tests on copy, creative, and audiences — optimize for pipeline, not vanity metrics

  • Identify and test region-specific channels (LinkedIn, local publications, industry directories)

Regional Events & Webinars

  • Plan and execute regional webinars targeting local personas and use cases

  • Identify and manage participation in regional conferences, trade shows, and industry meetups

  • Organize executive roundtables, dinners, and field events in key markets

  • Own the full event lifecycle: sourcing, promotion, on-site execution, and post-event follow-up sequences

Regional Market Development

  • Research and prioritize target markets and accounts within LATAM and EMEA

  • Build regional account lists from scratch using intent data, market research, and local knowledge

  • Adapt Oscilar’s positioning and value props for regional buyers — different pain points, regulatory environments, competitive landscapes

  • Identify and pursue co-marketing opportunities with regional partners, integrators, and industry groups

What You’ll Do

  • Launch Oscilar’s marketing presence in new regional markets from zero

  • Run outbound, paid, and event campaigns simultaneously across multiple markets

  • Localize and adapt campaign messaging, creative, and landing pages for regional audiences

  • Partner with Sales to build regional pipeline and account penetration strategies

  • Manage regional marketing budget and report on pipeline contribution by market

  • Iterate rapidly: launch campaigns, read the results, adjust, and relaunch

  • Build the repeatable playbook that future regional marketers will follow

What We’re Looking For

0-to-1 Growth Marketer

  • 5–7+ years in B2B growth or demand generation marketing

  • Proven experience launching marketing programs in new regions or markets where no playbook existed

  • Hands-on across outbound, paid, and events — you don’t just plan campaigns, you build and ship them

  • Track record of generating pipeline in international markets

Multi-Channel Operator

  • Fluent in the modern growth stack: Clay, Outreach, HeyReach, Nooks, Cargo, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Framer (or equivalents)

  • Can build a landing page, set up an outbound sequence, launch a paid campaign, and organize a webinar — all in the same week

  • Comfortable managing multiple markets and campaigns in parallel

Multilingual & Culturally Fluent

  • Fluent in English. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred

  • Deep familiarity with business culture and buying behavior in LATAM and/or EMEA markets

  • Can localize messaging beyond translation — you understand what resonates locally

Comfort with Ambiguity

  • You thrive in environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet

  • Can build account lists, campaign plans, and market entry strategies from incomplete data

  • Resourceful: you figure it out rather than wait for someone else to figure it out for you

Bonus Experience

  • Marketing to financial institutions or regulated industries in LATAM or EMEA

  • Experience at a company in the $5M–$50M ARR scaling phase

  • Run regional webinar programs or field events in multiple countries

  • Built outbound campaigns in non-English-speaking markets

  • Familiarity with regional data privacy regulations (GDPR, LGPD, etc.)

Why This Role Is Unique

At Oscilar, you will:

  • Build the international growth playbook from scratch — not inherit one

  • Be the first dedicated marketing hire for LATAM and EMEA — enormous ownership and impact

  • Have direct access to Sales leadership and the full GTM team

  • Operate with high autonomy, real budget, and a team that values execution over planning

  • Shape how Oscilar enters and wins in the world’s fastest-growing fintech markets

One More Thing

If you’ve read this far and don’t check every box but are convinced this role has your name on it — send a cold outbound email to

Bonus points if you include a mini go-to-market plan for one LATAM or EMEA market, or any creative campaigns you’ve run that punched above their weight.

We’ll read every one.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities

  • Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions

Die AI GROUP ist ein Unternehmen, das sich darauf spezialisiert hat, Künstliche Intelligenz in der Wirtschaft zu fördern und Unternehmen mit internationaler KI-Expertise zu unterstützen. Das Ziel ist es, die Einführung von KI zu beschleunigen und die Lücke zwischen Risikokapital, KI-Entwicklung und -Anwendung zu schließen.

Die AI GROUP ist ein wachsendes KI-Ökosystem, das seit vielen Jahren KI-Innovationen aus Deutschland und Europa sowie ihre Anwendung in der Wirtschaft fördert. Hervorgegangen aus der 2019 gegründeten AI HAMBURG, unterstützt die Gruppe Unternehmen dabei, die Chancen von KI für eine bessere Zukunft zu nutzen.

Unter dem Dach der AI GROUP bündelt AI HAMBURG zahlreiche Aktivitäten zur Förderung von KI-Anwendungen. Kern ist AI.HUB, eine unternehmerische Innovationsplattform, die Unternehmen und Startups von Training und Use-Case-Entwicklung über die Implementierung bis hin zur Skalierung begleitet.

Ergänzt wird das Ökosystem durch AI FUND, einen Early-Stage-VC-Fonds, sowie AI.IMPACT bietet individuelle KI-Beratung und Projektumsetzung an. Ebenfalls Teil des Ökosystems ist die AI ACADEMY.

Zusätzlich organisiert die AI GROUP Veranstaltungen wie den AI.SUMMIT am 24.11.26 im CCH, der führende Experten und Unternehmen zusammenbringt, sowie das AI CENTER, das innovative KI-Unternehmen auf großen Branchenmessen vernetzt.

Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Marketing & Communications bist du fester Teil unseres Marketing-Teams und arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing & Communications Management zusammen. Gemeinsam gestaltet ihr die Außenwirkung des gesamten AI GROUP-Ökosystems aktiv mit. Dein kurzfristiger Fokus liegt auf der Social-Media-Präsenz rund um den AI.SUMMIT 2026 – langfristig baust du den Social-Media-Auftritt des gesamten AI GROUP-Ökosystems weiter mit auf. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

  • Fokus AI.SUMMIT 2026: Kurzfristig verantwortest du – in enger Abstimmung mit dem Marketing & Communications Management – die Social-Media-Präsenz rund um den AI.SUMMIT, von der Ankündigung über Speaker- und Programm-Highlights bis zur Begleitung des Events.
  • Social-Media-Betreuung: Du betreust eigenständig die verschiedenen Social-Media-Accounts des AI GROUP-Ökosystems und sorgst für einen aktiven, konsistenten Auftritt.
  • Community Management & Engagement: Du interagierst mit Beiträgen und Kommentaren, teilst relevante Inhalte (Reposts) und hältst durch Likes und Reaktionen den Austausch mit unserer Community lebendig.
  • Kampagnen: Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Social-Media-Kampagnen.
  • Aufbau Instagram: Langfristig baust du die Instagram-Präsenz der AI GROUP mit auf und pflegst sie kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Format-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst neue Content-Formate für Social Media und bringst eigene kreative Ideen ein.
  • Mail-Kampagnen (optional): Bei Bedarf unterstützt du bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Mail- und Newsletter-Kampagnen.
  • Natürlich unterstützt du uns auch bei der allgemeinen Planung und Umsetzung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und hilfst dabei, unsere Community durch spannende Netzwerk- und Online-Events weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

  • Du absolvierst derzeit ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Fach – oder bist sehr social-media-affin.
  • Interesse an technischen Innovationen und künstlicher Intelligenz.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Social-Media-Plattformen (LinkedIn, Instagram & Co.) sowie ein gutes Gespür für Trends und Zielgruppen.
  • Du besitzt Kreativität, ein gutes Sprachgefühl und kannst zielgruppengerecht kommunizieren.
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Content-Erstellung bzw. Tools wie Canva, CapCut o. Ä. sind von Vorteil.
  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Community Management sind von Vorteil.
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Slack, Airtable sind ein Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- (C1+) und Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du hast mindestens 6 Monate Zeit und kannst das AI HAMBURG Team pro Woche 20 Stunden unterstützen.
  • Du lebst in Hamburg oder in der Region

Benefits

  • Eine spannende Herausforderung in einem der wichtigsten Technologiebereiche des 21. Jahrhunderts.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem kompetenten und kollegialen Team.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Marketing & Communications Managerin, von der du direkt lernst und die dich in deiner Entwicklung begleitet.
  • Ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes und inspirierendes Teamumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien.
  • Einblick in ein tiefgreifendes, internationales Netzwerk.
  • Flexibilität, damit du dein Studium auch neben dem Job meistern kannst.
  • Arbeiten aus dem Hamburger Büro an der Binnenalster.
  • Eine angemessene Vergütung von 15 Euro/Stunde.

Bitte bewirb dich mit deinem CV und einem kurzen Anschreiben (gern auch mit Beispielen deiner bisherigen Social-Media- oder Content-Arbeit). Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Maintenance Lead
jobs.location: Ashby de la Zouch, England, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Maintenance Lead
Ashby de la Zouch (Home of Hula Hoops, Space Raiders, Nik Naks and more)
On-site, Monday - Friday 08:00 - 16:00

Join our snack-loving team
We’re looking for a Maintenance Lead to join us at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you – this could be your next big move.

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

As a Maintenance Lead, you'll take ownership of Site Services maintenance, ensuring critical utilities and infrastructure are maintained to the highest standard. Your focus will be on maximising equipment reliability, reducing service interruptions and delivering effective asset care strategies across boilers, compressors, plant room equipment, effluent treatment systems and other Site Services assets.

You'll play a leading role in Health & Safety, ensuring maintenance activities are planned and carried out safely and in line with site procedures. This includes managing contractors, controlling permits to work, reviewing risk assessments and method statements, and ensuring robust isolation procedures and safe systems of work are in place before work begins.

Working closely with Engineering and Operations colleagues, you'll drive maintenance excellence by analysing losses, identifying improvement opportunities and implementing sustainable solutions. You'll support the delivery of Autonomous Maintenance, ensuring equipment remains safe, compliant and reliable.

You'll also play a key role in our zero loss journey, leading reliability improvements, supporting statutory compliance activities, delivering continuous improvement projects and providing technical expertise for capital projects across Site Services.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • £49,231 annual salary and annual salary review

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • Annual bonus scheme

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback and wellbeing support

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Leading Site Services performance
    Taking ownership of critical Site Services equipment including boilers, compressors, plant room equipment, effluent treatment systems and other infrastructure, ensuring assets are reliable, efficient and fit for purpose whilst maintaining a safe operating environment

  • Owning statutory servicing and inspections
    Ensuring all servicing, inspections and compliance activities are completed on time, with accurate records maintained and audit requirements met

  • Leading maintenance, contractor management and fault resolution activities
    Using your technical expertise to coordinate maintenance activities, supervise contractors, review risk assessments and method statements (RAMS), manage permits to work and drive effective repairs to maximise equipment reliability and minimise downtime

  • Owning Site Services compliance requirements
    Managing activities relating to LOLER inspections, legionella control, sprinkler systems, fire systems and other statutory requirements. Ensuring appropriate isolations, control measures and safe systems of work are in place to keep the site safe and compliant

  • Driving continuous improvement and Health & Safety excellence
    Identifying opportunities to improve equipment reliability, efficiency and performance while supporting the ongoing development of the Intersnack Working System (IWS) across Engineering. Promoting safe working practices, challenging unsafe behaviours, supporting incident investigations and ensuring Health & Safety actions are completed within agreed timescales


We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • A recognised Engineering Apprenticeship or Engineering qualification
    Combined with relevant experience maintaining Site Services, utilities or industrial equipment within a manufacturing environment

  • Strong mechanical and electrical engineering experience

jobs.title: Senior Manager Regulatory & Legal Affairs
jobs.description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

Als Senior Manager Regulatory & Legal Affairs (m/w/d) gestaltest du die regulatorischen und rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen, unter denen FlixTrain den Zugang zum deutschen und europäischen Schienenmarkt sichert - von der Bewertung eisenbahnrechtlicher Entwicklungen bis zur Vertretung unserer Interessen gegenüber Behörden und in Branchengremien. Du schaffst die regulatorische Grundlage für einen fairen und wirtschaftlichen Marktzugang und trägst so unmittelbar dazu bei, dass FlixTrain den Wettbewerb auf der Schiene langfristig mitgestaltet. In dieser Rolle bist du Teil eines zunächst zweiköpfigen Teams mit Fokus auf regulatorische und rechtliche Themen.

Über die Rolle

  • Du beobachtest, analysierst und bewertest eisenbahnrechtliche Entwicklungen, insbesondere zu ERegG, AEG sowie relevanter EU-Gesetzgebung 
  • Verfahren rund um Netzzugang und Trassenpreise analysierst und bewertest du, du übernimmst dabei die Kommunikation mit sowie die Verfahren vor der Bundesnetzagentur
  • Aus regulatorischer Perspektive unterstützt du die strategische Netzplanung 
  • Die Interessen von FlixTrain vertrittst du in Branchengremien und gegenüber externen Stakeholdern 
  • Als Schnittstelle arbeitest du eng mit den internen Teams Network Planning, Public Affairs und Legal zusammen 
  • Regulatorische Gesetzgebungsprozesse begleitest du, gelegentlich auch mit Bezug zu Wettbewerbsrecht und Public Affairs 

Über Dich

  • Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften oder ein wirtschafts- bzw. politikwissenschaftliches Studium mit regulatorischem Schwerpunkt mit 
  • Fünf bis sieben Jahre Berufserfahrung in regulatorischen oder juristischen Tätigkeiten zeichnen dich aus, idealerweise in einer regulierten Industrie wie Eisenbahn, Energie oder Telekommunikation 
  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Eisenbahnrechts sind von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung 
  • Im Umgang mit Regulierungsbehörden bist du erfahren und komplexe regulatorische Sachverhalte bereitest du klar und adressatengerecht auf
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1/C2) gehören zu deinem Profil, weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil 
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit runden dein Profil ab 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

jobs.title: Product Qualification Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.

Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.

  • Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work on test boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.

  • Set up and maintain qualification test equipment, including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.

  • Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed

  • Collect, analyze, and document qualification results, producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on product qualification experience with 2–4+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, bench testing, or product qualification test campaigns.

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. jobs.description:
Verantwortung übernehmen. Accounting weiterdenken.

Du möchtest nicht nur sicherstellen, dass die Buchhaltung zuverlässig läuft, sondern auch aktiv daran mitwirken, wie sie künftig noch effizienter gestaltet werden kann?

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen im ambulanten Gesundheitsbereich. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unsere kaufmännischen Prozesse bereits deutlich digitalisiert, neue Systeme eingeführt und zahlreiche Abläufe optimiert.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Ziel.

Unser Unternehmen wächst kontinuierlich – und mit ihm die Anforderungen an unsere Buchhaltung. Unser Ziel : Prozesse so aufzustellen, dass neue Gesellschaften und steigende Umsätze nicht automatisch zu einem proportionalen Anstieg des manuellen Aufwands führen.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Accounting fachlich sicher beherrscht und zugleich den Blick nach vorne richtet. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit uns an Lösungen arbeitet, die mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns verantwortest

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Accounting mehrerer Gesellschaften und sorgst dafür, dass die Buchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft sauber läuft.
  • Du verantwortest Monatsabschlüsse und UStVA sowie gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerberatern die Vorbereitung der Jahresabschlüsse.
  • Auch unser Forderungsmanagement gehört zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Du führst unser zweiköpfiges Accounting-Team und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit und Aufgabenverteilung im Team weiter.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Accounting-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie Abläufe einfacher, schneller und verlässlicher machen.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Finance-Tools, digitalen Workflows und Schnittstellen weiter und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Prozesse mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen können.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Steuerberater und die relevanten internen Bereiche.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist im Accounting fachlich zu Hause und hast mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung.
  • Monatsabschlüsse, Kontenabstimmungen, Umsatzsteuer und die Vorbereitung von Jahresabschlüssen sind für dich vertraute Themen.
  • Idealerweise bist du Bilanzbuchhalter/in, Steuerfachwirt/in oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.
  • Mit DATEV arbeitest du sicher; Erfahrung mit DATEV Unternehmen online ist von Vorteil.
  • Erste Führungserfahrung ist gut, aber kein Muss. Wichtig ist uns, dass du gerne Verantwortung für ein Team übernimmst.
  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und Automatisierung und probierst gerne aus, wie sich Abläufe einfacher und besser gestalten lassen.
  • Wenn ein Prozess jeden Monat wieder manuell ausgeführt wird, fragst du dich automatisch: Warum eigentlich?
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für einen wichtigen Bereich unseres Unternehmens und ein bestehendes Team.

Dabei startest du nicht bei null. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir bereits viel verändert und digitalisiert. Einige Prozesse funktionieren schon sehr gut, andere möchten wir gemeinsam verbessern.

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unsere Wege sind kurz – wenn wir gemeinsam zu dem Ergebnis kommen, dass ein Prozess oder ein System verändert werden sollte, können wir das auch umsetzen.

Dein Arbeitsort kann Duisburg, Berlin oder Hamburg sein. Da unser Accounting-Team aktuell in Duisburg sitzt, sollte eine regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort für dich möglich sein. Darüber hinaus arbeiten wir flexibel und standortübergreifend.

Und auch deine Rolle darf mitwachsen: Wenn du dich weiterentwickelst, kann sich mit der Zeit auch dein Verantwortungsbereich erweitern.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
jobs.description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

  • Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.

  • Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.

  • Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.

  • Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.

  • Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.

  • Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.

  • Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise

  • Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.

  • Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
  • Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
  • Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
  • Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
  • You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
    •  

    Partner with customers and internal teams

  • Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.

  • Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

  • Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

    •  

    Identify risks and opportunities

  • Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.

  • Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.

  • Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

    • Improve how we work

  • Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.

  • Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

  • Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

  • Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

    •  

    What you’ll need to succeed

  • Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

  • Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.

  • Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.

  • Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.

  • Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.

  • Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

  • Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.

  • Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.

  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.

  • Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

    • Why you should join Contentsquare
    We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
     
    Here are a few we want to highlight:
    - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
    - Lifestyle allowance
    - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
    - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
    - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
    - And more benefits tailored to each country
     
    Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
     
    Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
     
    Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
     
    Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

  • Own the electrical power system architecture for Hypersonica’s high-speed flight vehicles, ensuring generation, conversion, storage, distribution, protection, and monitoring functions operate as a coherent and resilient system. 

  • Define, manage, and maintain power system requirements, ensuring full traceability from mission and vehicle-level needs through subsystem design, verification, and validation. 

  • Develop power-system architectures and performance budgets covering voltage regulation, load management, efficiency, redundancy, thermal constraints, fault tolerance, and mission-critical availability. 

  • Lead the integration of power generation, battery systems, power electronics, energy storage, distribution networks, protection devices, and control systems across vehicle and payload architectures. 

  • Conduct electrical system analyses including load-flow, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments. 

  • Define and support system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, environmental qualification, and vehicle integration activities, using data-driven analysis to improve performance and mitigate risk. 

  • Produce and maintain critical engineering artefacts including specifications, electrical schematics, interface control documents (ICDs), analysis reports, verification plans, and design review material. 

  • Apply systems engineering and MBSE principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and flight-test outcomes. 

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks associated with power availability, thermal loading, EMC performance, reliability, safety, integration complexity, and operational resilience. 

  • Act as a technical authority across electrical power systems, collaborating closely with avionics, controls, software, thermal, mechanical, EMC, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust vehicle capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Power Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex electrical power, energy storage, avionics, aerospace, defence, automotive, space, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in electrical system architecture, requirements management, systems integration, verification, and validation across the full engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of electrical power generation, power conversion, battery systems, energy storage, power distribution, protection systems, and power electronics. 

  • Experienced in electrical analysis including load-flow studies, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments. 

  • Comfortable designing and integrating high-performance electrical power systems within highly constrained environments where weight, volume, efficiency, and thermal management are critical. 

  • Familiar with systems engineering and MBSE approaches, using structured methods to manage complexity, interfaces, traceability, and technical risk. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, qualification campaigns, integration programmes, and the transition from concept through detailed design and verification. 

  • Technically credible across multiple engineering disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction. 

  • Comfortable operating in ambitious, fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and engineering decisions have significant programme impact. 

  • Motivated by solving difficult engineering problems and delivering technologies that strengthen European sovereign defence capability. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 
 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for German Security Clearance. 


What we offer 
 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer  - Product (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.
 
About You and What You'll Do:
 
You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious – about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.
 
As a product-minded backend engineer, you don't just implement tickets. You understand the "why" behind what you're building, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to create better outcomes. You're comfortable discussing trade-offs with product managers, explaining technical constraints to business stakeholders, and collaborating with frontend and mobile engineers to design elegant end-to-end solutions.
 
You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.
 
You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains – you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.
 
Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.
 
 

Your experience includes:
  • At least 5 years of professional backend development with a product engineering mindset
  • Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#
  • Hands-on experience architecting and evolving distributed systems in production
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers from other disciplines
  • Strong business acumen – you understand how your work connects to company objectives
  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences
  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code

    • Our tech stack
  • Backend: .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, GCP.
  • You'll work alongside teams using React (Web), Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android), Python/ML frameworks, and modern test automation tools (Playwright, Appium).

    • Recruitment flow:

    • Recruiter Interview

    • First Technical Interview

    • System Design Interview

    • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

    • Offer


    What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU

jobs.title: On Holiday Support Agent
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne.

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Vous rejoignez l'équipe produit 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design, que vous aimez transformer une donnée complexe en visuel et que vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des interfaces au service de vrais enjeux data, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics. 

Ekimetrics est leader en data science et fournisseur de solutions AI. Depuis plus de 20 ans, nous utilisons la data science au service de l’optimisation de performance marketing, business et de la transition vers une performance plus durable. 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design d’interfaces élégantes et intuitives, que vous aimez transformer des idées en prototypes concrets et que vous rêvez d’expérimenter avec l’IA, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics ! 

Pourquoi recrutons nous ? 

L'équipe Produit conçoit des solutions data-driven et logiciels métier, centrées sur l'utilisateur, qui aident nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions business à partir de leurs données.  

Design, data science et développement travaillent main dans la main sur des problèmes concrets.  

Elle compte 30 personnes (full-stack developers, Product managers, Product owners, DevOps et Product designers) qui construisent les plateformes de data science et d'IA que nos clients utilisent au quotidien pour piloter leurs décisions. 

Pour accélérer la production de ces interfaces, améliorer les parcours de nos utilisateurs et recueillir leurs retours, nous recrutons un·e stagiaire UX/UI Designer, suivi·e par un product designer senior, avec une vraie autonomie sur des projets complets menés en s'appuyant sur le design system Ekimetrics, les méthodes agiles et selon la méthode du double diamant.  

Le process de recrutement :

  • Un entretien RH, 
  • Un entretien technique sur site 
  • Un entretien final.
Est attendu un portfolio démontrant d'au moins 3 projets variés ainsi qu'une expertise Figma et UI avancés 

Vos missions : 

  • Concevoir des flows, wireframes et maquettes : pas des écrans isolés, mais des parcours qui aident nos clients à décider. 

  • Contribuer au design system : comprendre pourquoi une règle existe avant de l'appliquer, puis la faire évoluer sans casser la cohérence entre nos produits. 

  • Participer aux ateliers UX et aux tests d'utilisabilité (Maze), et proposer des solutions argumentées. 

  • Travailler avec les product designers, les product owners et les développeurs. 

Profil recherché :  

  • Bac+5 en cours, en design, UX/UI ou multimédia interactif. 

  • Vous suivez les nouveaux produits et les tendances (design systems, IA appliquée au produit, nouvelles interactions), et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi ils fonctionnent. 

  • Vous maîtrisez Figma en profondeur (variables, auto-layout, composants). 

  • Pour vous, un design system est un système de règles, pas une bibliothèque de composants. Une connaissance de shadcn/ui ou d'un système équivalent est un plus. 

  • Vous défendez vos choix avec des arguments, pas seulement avec du goût. 

  • Vous gérez seul·e votre temps et vos priorités. 

  • Vous êtes proactif·ve et fiable sur les deadlines : vous partagez idées, doutes et avancement réel sans attendre qu'on vous le demande. 

Les petits plus : 

  • Des connaissances en accessibilité web seront appréciées
  • Des compétences à restituer en vidéo et sous forme de slides 

Modalités :  

  • Stage de 6 mois, démarrage prévu entre janvier et mars 2027. 

  • Software : Jira, Figma et Maze. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.  

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.  

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. 

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.  

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.

  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
