jobs.title: Praktikum Digital Analytics (m/w/d)| Ab September, München
jobs.description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

  • AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
  • SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
  • Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
  • Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.
  • Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt.
  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein.
  • Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
  • Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.
  • Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast.

  • Ein Thema mit Zukunft: AI Search ist keine Nische, die wieder verschwindet. Was du hier lernst, ist in zwei Jahren ein gesuchtes Profil und du kannst dann belegen, dass du von Anfang an dabei warst.
  • Echte Betreuung: Feste Ansprechperson, wöchentlicher Jour fixe, Zwischen- und Abschlussfeedback. Kein „Melde dich, wenn du was brauchst“.
  • Übernahmeperspektive, ehrlich benannt: Wir bauen dieses Feld auf und suchen parallel auf Senior-Level. Wenn es passt, ist der Weg über Junior in eine der beiden Rollen realistisch – wir versprechen es nicht, aber wir meinen es.
  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität – Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich, auch als Praktikant:in.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bekommen Studium und Praktikum zusammen. Prüfungszeiten planen wir ein, wenn du sie früh sagst.
  • Mobility & Events: Öffi-Ticket-Zuschuss, Teamevents und die Chance, auf Fachkonferenzen mitzufahren.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.

jobs.description:
IDEEMATEC is one of the world's leading manufacturers of utility-scale solar trackers and the global technology leader in Agri-PV. Our trackers offer unique advantages such as high reliability across the entire lifecycle, resulting in low levelized cost of electricity (LCOE).

As a pioneer of commercial solar trackers in agriculture, our Agri-PV solutions open up a new market segment to combine cost-efficient power generation with agricultural use.

With more than 10 GW of installed projects worldwide, we are entering our next phase of growth. Alongside our international markets, Germany holds high strategic priority as our home market.

Our customers include independent power producers (IPPs), major project developers, EPC companies, utilities, and strategic investors. Together with them, we develop solutions that not only optimize individual projects but make entire project portfolios more efficient, resilient, and economical.

We are growing internationally and are looking for people who think entrepreneurially, take ownership, and want to help shape the next generation of global solar infrastructure with us.

Preparing strategic decisions, bringing the Supervisory Board and Management Board together, actively shaping the company's next stage of growth: a lot comes together in the Office of the CEO that is critical to IDEEMATEC.

You prepare the Management Board's substantive decisions, support the collaboration with the Supervisory Board, and steer cross-functional projects and special topics directly on behalf of the CEO. You translate strategic priorities effectively into the organization and help shape key strategic decisions.

Your workplace is one of our three Bavarian locations: Ismaning, Neusling, or Plattling.

Aufgaben

Strategy & Decision Preparation

  • Independently managing and further developing KPI dashboards and management reporting, including commentary and interpretation of results

Project & Results Responsibility

  • Independently steering cross-functional projects and special topics directly on behalf of the Management Board, including scheduling, resource coordination, and results responsibility
  • Taking on special projects of high strategic relevance, for example in the development of new locations, business areas, or further growth initiatives, as well as supporting international topics and projects at our locations in Spain and North America

Organization, Processes & Digitalization

  • Contributing to the further development of corporate strategy, processes, and organizational structures

Moderation & Interfaces

  • Independently moderating strategy workshops and project steering committees, as well as coordinating professionally with executives and project stakeholders
  • Acting as the link between the Management Board and business functions by translating strategic guidance into the organization and feeding back relevant developments, risks, and decisions needed

Qualifikation

Education & Experience

  • Completed degree in business administration, industrial engineering, engineering, or a comparable field – at least a Bachelor's degree, Master's preferred, ideally with a quantitative focus
  • Several years of professional experience in strategic positions, e.g. in an executive-support or chief-of-staff-type role and/or in management consulting
  • At least one year of experience abroad (professional and/or academic)
  • Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects

Professional Skills

  • Solid knowledge of data analysis, reporting, and process optimization, as well as basic knowledge of budgeting

  • Excellent analytical and conceptual skills, along with the ability to structure complex issues and communicate them clearly to different audiences
  • Confident and thoughtful use of AI tools (e.g. for research, data analysis, and preparing decision papers)

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written; additional languages are a plus

Personality & Presence

  • Confident presence and strong communication skills at all levels of the hierarchy and in an international environment
  • A strong sense for informal networks and the ability to build trust and willingness to cooperate
  • High drive for execution, along with a structured, independent, and results-oriented way of working, with a strong sense of responsibility and discretion

Benefits

We value open communication, support your professional growth, and give you the freedom to take ownership from day one. With exciting global projects and a strong sense of purpose, IDEEMATEC offers a workplace where your work has impact and your strengths truly make a difference.

  • Modern equipment and flexible hybrid working model
  • 30 days of vacation and flexible working hours

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du entwickelst Hooks, Angles und Advertorials, die bei Cold Traffic verkaufen - und misst deine Ideen daran, was konvertiert, nicht daran, wie schön sie aussehen? Du testest strukturiert, iterierst Gewinner und tötest Verlierer ohne Wehmut? Dann lies weiter.

Wir bei BodyFokus sind der Longevity-Lebensbegleiter für Mensch und Hund. Über unsere Marken BodyFokus, BeautyFokus und PetFokus helfen wir mehr als 250.000 Menschen und ihren Hunden im DACH-Raum, ihre Gesundheit aktiv in die Hand zu nehmen. Wir sind schnell, ergebnisorientiert und haben wenig übrig für Bürokratie - am Ende zählt das Ergebnis, nicht der vorgeschriebene Weg dorthin.

Als Creative Strategist bist du der Kreativ-Motor unserer Neukundengewinnung. Bei uns entscheiden Hook und Angle über den Großteil der Performance - der Rest ist Ausführung. Über alle drei Marken hinweg entwickelst du die Advertorials und UGC-Konzepte, die kalten Traffic in Kunden verwandeln - Hand in Hand mit dem Team.

Bei uns läuft alles AI- und Agent-gestützt: Du nutzt KI und eigene Agenten-Workflows als Hebel für Tempo und Menge - Varianten und Copy im Akkord - und filterst die besten Ideen mit klarem Urteil heraus. Die KI ist dein Hebel, nicht deine Ausrede.

Aufgaben

  • Creative Strategy & Angles: Hooks, Angles und Advertorial-Konzepte über BodyFokus, BeautyFokus und PetFokus entwickeln, die bei Cold Traffic auf Meta und Co. stoppen und verkaufen.
  • Ad-Konzepte: Konzepte für Bild- und Video-Ads entwickeln, Creator, Designer und Cutter briefen und steuern.
  • Angles aus echten Daten: Reviews, Support-Anfragen und CRM-Gespräche nach echten Pain Points, der Sprache der Kunden und ungenutzten Zielgruppen durchforsten - deine Angles kommen aus Daten, nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Creative Testing: feste Taktung neuer Angles und Varianten pro Woche. Gewinner iterieren, müde Creatives abschalten - gemessen an Hook-Rate, CTR, CVR und dem Effekt auf den CAC.
  • Creative Review: Du wertest vergangene Creatives systematisch aus, statt nur den nächsten Test zu starten. Aus Gewinnern und Verlierern liest du Muster heraus — welcher Pain Point trägt, welche Formulierung stoppt, welche Audience auf welches Versprechen reagiert — und schärfst damit laufend den Fit zwischen Audience und Produkt. Jede Testrunde startet klüger als die letzte.
  • Schulter an Schulter mit Paid: eng mit dem Team arbeiten, damit Anzeige, Advertorial und Produktseite als Einheit funktionieren.
  • KI & Agenten-Workflows: eigene AI- und Agenten-Prozesse aufsetzen, die Recherche, Varianten und Auswertung beschleunigen.

Qualifikation

  • Direct-Response-Creative aus eigener Praxis: Du hast Hooks, Angles und Advertorials konzipiert, die bei Cold Traffic verkauft haben - und kannst deine Zahlen benennen (Winning-Rate, CTR, CVR, Effekt auf den CAC).
  • Advertorial- und Copy-Handwerk: Du kennst die Klaviatur - problembewusste Hooks, Open Loops, hohe Neugier - und weißt, wie ein Advertorial bei Cold Traffic verkauft und woran ein Hook scheitert. Aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Plattform-Guidelines.
  • Creative plus Zahlen: Du beurteilst Creatives danach, was konvertiert, nicht danach, was gefällt.
  • Tempo vor Perfektion: Du produzierst lieber viele Angles und lässt den Markt entscheiden, statt ewig am "perfekten" Creative zu feilen. Du weißt: Man muss auch mal schlecht sein, um richtig gut zu werden.
  • Consumer-Gespür und AI-first: Du triffst, was Gesundheits-, Beauty- und Hunde-KundInnen zum Klicken und Kaufen bringt, und nutzt KI als Hebel dafür.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, fließendes Englisch.

Wichtig: Bei uns steht Performance an erster Stelle, und unsere Funnel sind Verkaufsgespräche, kein Markenschaufenster. Handwerk und Ästhetik gehören dazu - aber auf dem Fundament der Zahl. Wenn dein Zuhause klassisches Marken-, Design- oder Award-Creative ohne Verantwortung dafür ist, was am Ende verkauft, ist das nicht die richtige Rolle für dich.

Du deckst nicht jeden Punkt ab, bringst aber nachweisbar Creatives mit, die verkauft haben? Bewirb dich trotzdem - überzeug uns mit Beispielen und Zahlen.

Benefits

Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als Creative Strategist (m/w/d) verwandelst du Performance-daten in die Roadmap für Creative-Tests. Du entscheidest, was getestet wird, warum es getestet wird, und briefst die Producers, damit unsere Creative-Engine schnell lernt und den CAC nachhaltig senkt. Du bildest die Brücke zwischen den Daten des Media-Teams und dem Output des Creative-Teams: Du bist die Person, die sicherstellt, dass wir nicht nur Masse produzieren, sondern genau die richtige Masse.

Aufgaben

  • Werbemittel-Performance gemeinsam mit dem User-Acquisition- und Daten-Team analysieren; identifizieren, was funktioniert und warum.
  • Konzepte, Hooks, Angles und Formate entwickeln; die Testing-Roadmap sowie die Priorisierung eigenverantwortlich steuern.
  • Das Producer-Team mit klaren, messbaren und testbaren Creative-Briefings anleiten.
  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Trend-Analysen durchführen (TikTok, Meta sowie branchenspezifische Channels).
  • Erkenntnisse aus der Performance-Analyse direkt in die nächste Creative-Produktion einfließen lassen.
  • Eng mit Media Buying, Produktion, Copywriting und Brand Management zusammenarbeiten – unter strikter Einhaltung der rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. GlüStV).

Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle (Impact):

  • Strukturiertes Testing-System aufbauen: Ein klares Framework für Creative-Tests entwickeln – von der Hypothese über die Formate bis zur Test-Sequenzierung.
  • Datengestützte Ideation: Systematisch neue Hooks, Konzepte und Blickwinkel (Angles) auf Basis von Leistungsdaten und aktuellen Trends entwickeln.
  • Performance steigern: Die Erfolgsquote von Gewinner-Creatives erhöhen sowie CTR, Hook-Rate und Conversion-Rate im Paid Marketing nachhaltig verbessern.
  • Wissensdatenbank aufbauen: Eine Lern-Bibliothek für Creatives pflegen, damit Erkenntnisse langfristig wachsen, statt bei jedem Test verloren zu gehen.
  • Produktion beschleunigen: Den Prozess vom Briefing bis zum fertigen Test-Creative gemeinsam mit den Producers deutlich verkürzen.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Tiefes Verständnis für Paid-Social-Creatives (insbesondere Meta und TikTok).
  • Fähigkeit, Ad-Performance-Kennzahlen zu lesen und direkt in strategische Creative-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.
  • Starke Fähigkeiten in der Entwicklung von Konzepten und Aufhängern (Hooks).
  • Präzise und klare Anweisung (Briefing) von Creative Producers.
  • Hohes Verständnis für plattform-native Formate und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends.
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung in regulierten Märkten (z. B. Lotterie, Fintech, Gaming, Glücksspiel).
  • Hintergrund im Bereich Direct-Response- / Performance-Marketing.
  • Leichte, praktische Kenntnisse im Video-Schnitt (Hands-on-Editing).

Deine Soft Skills:

  • Du lebst an der Kreuzung von Daten und Kreativität und fühlst dich mit Kennzahlen genauso wohl wie mit kreativen Ideen.
  • Du gehst strukturiert sowie hypothesengeleitet vor und siehst Werbemittel als gezielte Tests, die du fortlaufend optimierst.

Für unsere beiden Marken Adam & Eve Beauty und Adam & Eve Medical suchen wir einen Marketing Manager (m/w/d), der Lust hat, zwei unterschiedliche Markenwelten aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Beauty ist emotional, schnell, trendgetrieben und nah an Social Media. Medical braucht Vertrauen, Expertise, hochwertige Kommunikation und ein feines Gespür für medizinische Ästhetik.

Du verstehst diesen Unterschied – und weißt gleichzeitig, wie aus einer starken Marke Reichweite, relevante Leads, Neukunden und langfristige Kundenbindung entstehen.

Wir suchen keinen reinen Verwalter, sondern jemanden, der mitdenkt, Ideen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge ins Machen bringt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Marketingstrategie für Adam & Eve Beauty und Adam & Eve Medical
  • Planung und Steuerung von Kampagnen über alle relevanten Kanäle
  • Entwicklung von Content-, Social-Media- und Kampagnenkonzepten

Bei Adam & Eve bekommst du echten Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung für zwei Marken, die sich in unterschiedlichen Märkten bewegen und gleichzeitig viele Synergien bieten.

In this role, you will:

  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

Your primary focus is establishing a scalable, globally consistent lighting strategy that defines how every Neko space feels the moment someone walks in. You will develop lighting standards for the Location Design Playbook, drive lighting innovation for next-generation scanning environments and clinic typologies and provide concept-level creative guidance to regional design teams delivering projects globally.

This role reports to the Architecture Creative Studio Lead and partners closely with the Architecture Design Studio Leads for the US and Europe, the Industrial Design Lead, and cross-functional teams in Arts and Graphics, Hardware, Medical Excellence, and Operations.

  • A comprehensive global lighting design standard is documented in the Location Design Playbook, covering all key clinic zones (scan rooms, consultation areas, waiting areas, circulation, and back-of-house) ready for regional teams to implement consistently.

Minimum Requirements

  • Deep understanding of lighting technology i.e. LED systems, controls and integration with building management systems.

  • Experience collaborating with architects, interior designers, and engineering teams to integrate lighting seamlessly into spatial design.

  • Experience in developing interactive lighting solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Enterprise Trust & Reliability
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

Enterprise Trust & Reliability (ETR) turns enterprise trust into enterprise revenue. It's where enterprise buyers decide whether they can adopt us: the compliance posture and evidence base we sell on, the operational reliability that keeps us dependable at scale, and the integrations and partnerships that make Multiverse procurement-ready. Far from a support function, it's the layer that makes enterprise adoption possible and drives client partnerships and revenue at scale.

You'll lead the engineering for two of ETR's groups, Commercial Tech & Integrations and Stability & Operations: around seven engineers across the two, and the mandate to shape how they work.

Why the role exists

ETR is a newly formed function, built by bringing commercial integrations and operational reliability together because enterprise buyers make or break AI deals on exactly those things. You're the first dedicated engineering manager for these teams, with the mandate to build how they work from here: technical direction alongside the tech leads, delivery rhythm, growth plans, the hiring bar, on-call practice, all of it. You’ll report into the Single Threaded Leader for the function and together you will shape an evolving function - if you want to set the technical playbook, this is the role.

The teams you'll lead

Commercial Tech & Integrations (CTI) bridges what we sell and what we ship, making Multiverse demonstrable, sellable, and procurement-ready. It owns key cross functional services, CRM data flows into product, customer onboarding friction reduction, and integrations into customer systems (e.g. LMS/KMS). It also runs vendor and partner integrations, including Anthropic. The engineering challenge is building clean, well-tested APIs and integrations that hold up under enterprise security reviews.

Stability & Operations (S&O) keeps the platform dependable as it scales: incident management and the severity model, service-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets, observability and DORA (DevOps Research and Assessment) delivery metrics, the on-call rotation, and the technology evidence base the business needs as it approaches IPO. The engineering challenge here is reliability designed in rather than bolted on, and a fast, calm path from "something's wrong" to "it's fixed."

Between them, these two teams carry the things enterprise buyers test hardest: can you integrate with us cleanly, and will you stay up. You own the engineering health and delivery of both.

What you'll do

You'll own delivery, technical direction, and team health across CTI and S&O:

  • Lead the engineers. Line-manage the seven-or-so engineers across the two groups: growth plans, coaching, performance, and wellbeing, to a high bar, with no surprises at review time.

  • Own delivery and technical direction. Partner with the tech leads on architecture, and hold the standard for how the teams design, review, and ship across two quite different technical domains.

  • Hire and raise the bar. Fill the open seats using our High-Agency & AI-Native question bank and a live AI build stage, and build a team that stays strong as it grows.

  • Drive an AI-native operating rhythm. Engineers using Claude Code and agentic tooling hard, with tighter discovery-to-build-to-review loops, and you modelling it in how you run the teams.

  • Own the operational backbone. On-call health, incident practice, and clear, proactive communication when things go wrong, so reliability is a habit rather than a fire drill.

What we're looking for

  • Engineering management at depth. You've managed engineers building and running production systems, and you can speak to the teams you've grown, the delivery you've owned, and the performance calls you've made.

  • Technical range across both domains. You needn't be the deepest expert in either, but you hold your own with senior engineers on both sides: integration and API design, identity and SSO, and third-party systems on the CTI side; reliability, observability, incident response, and SLOs on the S&O side. You can steer a design review, challenge an estimate, and make a sensible build-versus-buy or sequencing call. This isn't a hands-on coding seat, but it is an engineering one.

  • Delivery through ambiguity. You've kept teams shipping when the structure wasn't fixed, and can talk to how you balanced pace, quality, and people.

  • You grow people. Engineers you've coached, mentored, or levelled up, and a real preference for people leadership as the job.

  • AI-native by default. You work with AI tooling day to day and expect your engineers to, and you can tell AI-assisted speed from AI-shaped slop.

What we offer

Pre-IPO equity with runway to vest before a potential exit. An AI-native engineering environment built around tools like Claude Code. And dynamic re-teaming: you accumulate breadth across missions rather than depth in one fixed lane, and your development travels with you through every team change. Because this mandate is first-of-its-kind, you're defining how engineering management works here, not stepping into someone else's template.

Not for you if

You want to stay predominantly hands-on in the code (we value and pay the engineering track equally), or you see management as a stepping stone rather than the work itself.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

Every foundation model lab is solving the same problem: build more capability. Almost nobody is solving the harder one — what happens when that capability meets a real organisation and real people who have to relearn how they work. Diagnose & Prescribe (D&P) is the engine room of that problem. It works out what a learner or employer actually needs, then decides what they get funded for and which apprenticeship or learning path they're pointed to next. D&P is how we assess a learner's or employer's skill gaps, decide what they need, and point them to the right apprenticeship or learning path — so the blast radius here is human and financial, not just a dashboard metric.

The line between leading this team and building the product has already blurred, which is why this role exists as it does. We need a leader who stays close enough to the work to have credible judgment in it, and who builds a high-trust team where diverse perspectives actually make the problem-solving better.

This is a broad, domain-coherent, event-driven and increasingly AI-native estate. The dominant challenge isn't deep algorithmic difficulty in any single repo — it's holding the whole D&P picture, sequencing work across varied services, and keeping load-bearing decisions safe as the system evolves underneath you.

What you're signing up for

  • A genuinely unsolved problem — the constraint here is people and adoption, not model capability.

  • High agency. We set outcomes, not playbooks. You and your team define how this evolves.

  • Real commercial breadth. This team sits at the intersection of Product, go-to-market, and eligibility — closer to the customer than most engineering roles.

  • Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment.

  • A company mid-transformation, told straight. Multiverse is rebuilding itself into a product-powered, AI-native company in real time. You're not inheriting a finished system — you're one of the people defining it.

What you'll do

You will own delivery, technical direction, and team health in the D&P service estate — the full learner and customer journey from diagnosis through prescription to onboarding and growth tracking. Concretely, that means leading the team(s) across surfaces like:

  • Diagnosis & needs assessment — AI-heavy services (retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-scored assessment) that turn raw signal into a picture of where a learner or employer actually is.

  • Prescription & eligibility — build the product which helps learners and customers understand the best learning course for their skills and career development, that leverages a customer's levy funds. Much of this is load-bearing logic with a genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners.

  • The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale.

  • Coach and build the team. Hire well, give every report a real growth plan, and move the team into a high-performing, AI-native operating rhythm — promotions and performance issues are never a surprise.

  • Stay hands-on. Whiteboard distributed designs, review and negotiate the RabbitMQ event schemas and API contracts that ripple across services, and write production code yourself when it's the fastest way to de-risk or unblock.

  • Deliver predictably. Use cycle time, change failure rate, and MTTR to balance shipping speed, debt, and change-safety on logic with genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Raise the AI-native bar. Prove better discovery-to-build-to-review loops on your own team and share what works across engineering.

  • Partner on strategy. Work directly with Product and Design — and closely with go-to-market — to turn learner and customer behaviour into technical direction on the surfaces where eligibility and recommendation decisions become visible to real customers.

What we need

A few terms you'll see below: D&P (Diagnose & Prescribe, this team's name), BAM (our hiring framework — Behaviour, Achievement, Mastery), ADRs (architecture decision records), IfATE (the UK body governing apprenticeship standards).

  • Engineering management of full-stack teams shipping production software, with real technical depth to review architecture and challenge design.

  • A team you led has shipped AI features to real users and operated them — not a side experiment.

  • Strong Python/TypeScript (if you don’t have Typescript, you will need to learn): React/Next.js (App Router, RSC, server actions), tRPC/GraphQL, Node/Express.

  • PostgreSQL at scale via an ORM, with migration discipline on large, live schemas.

  • Event-driven systems on a message bus (we use RabbitMQ) — versioned events, idempotency, backward-compatible migration.

  • A high engineering maturity bar as second nature: typing, testing, feature flags, ADRs, CI/CD, observability.

  • AI-native delivery in practice — you build daily with Claude Code, Cursor, or the current best tool, and understand context management, model selection, tool design, and the token economics that separate a prototype from an affordable production system.

What sets you apart

  • GTM/acquisition-funnel experience — you've owned surfaces where onboarding and eligibility meet real customers.

  • Strangler-pattern pragmatism — legacy monolith and greenfield edge-native product, at the same time.

  • Accessibility and UX as defaults on learner-facing surfaces, not afterthoughts.

Not for you if

This role won't fit if you'd rather run ceremonies than stay in the system, the design, and the code yourself. It also won't fit if you see AI tooling as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates the scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

Stack & how we lead

TypeScript core (React/Next.js, Node) with PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ as the event backbone, plus Python and Elixir services — from RAG pipelines to a Claude-powered edge-native product. GitHub, CircleCI, Datadog. AI-assisted development is first-class, not bolted on.

You'll lead full-stack engineers (with Python/Elixir specialists), report to the Senior Director of Engineering for Diagnose & Prescribe, and calibrate regularly with a peer group of EMs — you're not doing this alone. We reject micro-management: we set the objective, you and your team own the how. Kindness, candour, and curiosity over hierarchy — bad news travels as fast as good.

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e : Évaluation de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’Ingénieur.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée.

Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles.

Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.

 

Le recrutement d’un.e Ingénieur.e de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.

 ·         Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes.

·         Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés.

·         Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent, ou d’une thèse.

Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle.

Et idéalement :

·      Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes.

·      Junior accepté : Oui

·      Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).

 

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

•           Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle.

•           Vous possédez une expérience pratique des techniques d’injection de fautes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 46 /49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt

  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance

  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (AI Data Solutions)
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? This role

will focus on developing new business relationships and act as a strategic customer partner within the AI Solutions group (DataForce). DataForce is a rapidly growing service offering high quality data for Human Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching and processing training data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.

DataForce is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide and we are recruiting globally.

Key position responsibilities:

• Identify potential clients in the target market and complete appropriate research on the prospective client’s business and technical needs

• Identify, qualify and quantify opportunities

• Drive opportunities from lead generation all the way to closure

• Ensure customer success and satisfaction

• Draft and implement business plans

• Understand client’s business and technical requirements

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date on industry news

• Keep track of business opportunities on TransPerfect’s CRM system

• Coordinate production and technology teams across different time zones and cultures

• Generate and manage high-value profitable business deals

• Identify, track and manage KPIs and provide internal and client facing status reports; providing of executive updates including account progress, health, risk and opportunities

• Attend tradeshows and support marketing efforts by contributing to case studies and social media

• Provide accurate weekly forecasts and daily update reports

• Assist in building overall plans/budgets and subsequent adherence; own the overall financial health of assigned client engagements; drive efficiencies across process, people and technology

• Manage stakeholder communication around owned business and accounts

• Assist in training and adoption of technologies and services for internal and client teams

• Propose and implement new innovative offerings


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior communication skills

  • Proven track record in achieving sales target within the AI industry

jobs.title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
jobs.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
  • Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events.
  • Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models.

  • PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning.
  • Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation.
  • Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation.
  • Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data.
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') 
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45' - 60') 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work 
  • Meeting with the team
  • Offer 


Beyond That:
At Quandela, we value scientific curiosity, experimentation and collaboration. If you're passionate about quantum optics, spin physics and quantum technologies, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. 

If you're excited by the challenge of turning scientific ideas into demonstrations, advancing the building blocks of future quantum computing systems and working alongside physicists, engineers and theorists, let's talk.

Pourquoi ce poste est important ?

Chez Exotec, nous concevons et maintenons des systèmes robotiques de pointe qui transforment les entrepôts dans le monde entier. Chaque jour, notre technologie contribue à rendre les opérations plus sûres, plus rapides et moins exigeantes physiquement. En tant que Technicien de Maintenance, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bon fonctionnement de ces systèmes et offrir des performances exceptionnelles à nos clients.

Pourquoi vous apprécierez travailler chez nous ?

  • Travailler avec des technologies robotiques de dernière génération.
  • Rejoindre de petites équipes soudées où chacun a un réel impact.
  • Évoluer dans des environnements de travail modernes et propres.
  • Bénéficier d’une grande autonomie pour diagnostiquer les problèmes et trouver des solutions.

Vos missions

  • Assurer le fonctionnement optimal du système Skypod® et de notre flotte de robots.
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes mécaniques, électriques et logicielles.
  • Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les sites clients.
  • Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour résoudre des problématiques complexes.
  • Améliorer la fiabilité des systèmes et les performances clients.
  • Participer à la formation des clients et offrir une expérience de service d’excellence.

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Salaire annuel brut compétitif + prime d’équipe/poste + augmentation salariale complémentaire (%) selon l’organisation du temps de travail applicable et conformément à la convention collective + bonus annuel ExoBonus.
  • Tickets restaurant, RTT, mutuelle compétitive, prime vacances.
  • Organisation du travail du lundi au vendredi. Travail de nuit et le week-end de manière occasionnelle.
  • Horaires :
    • En journée : 9h-18h (39h hebdomadaire)
  • Déplacements hebdomadaires à prévoir entre différents sites : Guilherand-Granges, Saint Vulbas, Belleville-en-Beaujolais.
  • Véhicule de service mis à disposition.

Requirements

Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en maintenance industrielle, avec de solides compétences en diagnostic mécanique et électrique.

  • Connaissance pratique de la maintenance préventive et corrective sur :
    • systèmes de convoyage,
    • roulements,
    • courroies,
    • chaînes,
    • rouleaux,
    • moteurs,
    • variateurs,
    • capteurs,
    • actionneurs.

  • Capacité à lire des schémas électriques, surveiller les performances des systèmes et réaliser un premier niveau de diagnostic logiciel.
  • Calme et fiable, capable de résoudre rapidement les pannes, d’identifier les causes racines et de prendre des décisions sous pression.
  • Esprit curieux, sens du service client, goût du travail en équipe et excellente communication.

Processus de recrutement

Rejoignez-nous en seulement 2 semaines !

  1. Postulez en ligne.
  2. Notre objectif est de vous contacter sous 5 jours pour un premier échange téléphonique.
  3. Dans les 5 jours suivants, nous vous inviterons à visiter le site, rencontrer l’équipe, réaliser un exercice technique de diagnostic de panne et échanger avec le responsable du recrutement.
  4. Réception de votre proposition d’embauche dans les 4 jours suivant les entretiens.

Benefits

    • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
    • Politique famille avantageuse
    • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
    • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi.

Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences.
En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Cloud & Réseaux
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Nous favorisons un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable, ouvert à tous les genres.

Si vous n'avez pas toutes les qualifications requises mais que ce poste vous intéresse, postulez sans hésiter.

Poste basé à Wasquehal.

Rattaché(e) au Digital Workplace Manager, vous rejoignez une équipe IT de 7 personnes.
Votre périmètre couvre deux dimensions complémentaires : l'administration des environnements cloud et la gestion de l'infrastructure réseau interne. Vous garantissez la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité des systèmes qui font tourner le quotidien de l'ensemble des collaborateurs Exotec. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des équipes DSI, mais également des équipes Produit pour tout ce qui touche aux besoins d'infrastructure.
Ce rôle s'inscrit dans une organisation IT structurée, avec de vraies responsabilités techniques dès votre prise de poste.

Le Challenge
Exotec opère dans un environnement multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) en constante évolution, au service de plus de 1 300 collaborateurs répartis dans le monde. La maîtrise de cette infrastructure est un enjeu de continuité et de performance pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
Votre défi :

  • Prise en main de l'infrastructure: Acquérir une compréhension complète et approfondie de nos environnements cloud et réseau pour gagner rapidement en autonomie
  • Optimisation des environnements: Identifier les axes d'amélioration et contribuer activement à la rationalisation et la performance de l'infra existante
  • Être force de proposition pour faire évoluer l'infrastructure dans le bon sens, en anticipant les besoins plutôt qu'en subissant les contraintes
  • Collaboration transverse : Tisser des relations de confiance avec les équipes internes pour mieux anticiper et répondre à leurs besoins


Missions principales

1. Optimisation et amélioration continue
Vous analysez les environnements en place, proposez des pistes d'optimisation (coût, performance, résilience) et participez activement à leur mise en œuvre en lien avec l'équipe.

2. Support au déploiement applicatif
Vous accompagnez les équipes de développement dans le déploiement de leurs applications sur Kubernetes, en assurant le lien entre les besoins applicatifs et les contraintes d'infrastructure.

3. Administration et fiabilité des environnements cloud
Vous assurez l'exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance des infrastructures Azure et AWS. Vous êtes garant(e) de leur disponibilité et de leur performance au quotidien.
4. Infrastructure réseau
Vous pilotez l'installation et le maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'infrastructure réseau sur l'ensemble des sites Exotec. Vous prenez en charge la configuration et la gestion du matériel d'interconnexion (routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi Huawei/Unifi) et garantissez la qualité et la continuité des connexions pour l'ensemble des collaborateurs.
5. Sécurité de l'infrastructure
Vous appliquez et faites évoluer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité sur l'ensemble du périmètre : durcissement des configurations, gestion des accès privilégiés, et vigilance sur les vecteurs de risque courants.
6. Gestion des incidents & continuité de service
Vous assurez la prise en charge et l'escalade des incidents d'infrastructure, en veillant à la rapidité et à la qualité de résolution. Vous contribuez à la définition et au maintien des dispositifs de continuité (PRA/PCA) pour garantir la résilience des services IT.
7. Documentation et capitalisation
Vous maintenez une documentation technique à jour et de qualité, afin de garantir la lisibilité de l'infrastructure et faciliter la collaboration au sein de l'équipe IT.

Requirements

Expérience

  • +3 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement multi-cloud
  • Expérience concrète sur des infrastructures Azure et/ou AWS en production


Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise d'Azure et AWS (administration, IAM, réseaux virtuels, monitoring)
  • Solides bases en réseau : VLAN, Firewall, LAN/WAN, routage, VPN (IPSec/OpenVPN)
  • Solides bases en Linux
  • IaC / DevOps : Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Gitlab
  • Notions de sécurité infrastructure (durcissement, gestion des accès, bonnes pratiques cloud)


Soft skills

  • Autonomie et rigueur dans la gestion de son périmètre
  • Curiosité technique et appétence pour l'amélioration continue
  • Bonne communication, à l'aise dans un environnement multi-équipes
  • Ouverture aux outils d'intelligence artificielle et volonté de les intégrer dans ses pratiques de travail
  • Anglais courant requis (écrit & oral) — environnement international

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Primes collectives
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Flemish speaker
jobs.description:
MotorK. Driving the AI revolution in automotive.

MotorK is Europe's leading sales and marketing technology company for the automotive sector. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.

We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team to be based in our Antwerp office. This role would require a relocation to Belgium. 

The Role

The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:

  • Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership.
  • Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer’s digital strategy and signed SLA.
  • Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution.
  • Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals.
  • Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method.
  • Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates.

Requirements

Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.

As well as:

  • Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry.
  • Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Native Flemish speaker, fluency in French and English.
  • A proactive, goal-oriented approach with a passion for digital technologies and automotive innovation.

Work Pattern and Location

  • Permanent contract, full time
  • Monday – Friday
  • Hybrid role with occasional field trips 
  • Location: Antwerp

Benefits

  • Salary range: 40k-50k depending on experience
  • Commission plan: between 10 and 20% of fixed salary
  • Relocation support package
  • Meal Vouchers (for each day worked) 8€
  • ECO Vouchers 
  • Hospitalisation Insurance 
  • Mobile phone and SIM 
  • Three days of onboarding in our Milan office, with evening team building event
  • Bi-monthly appointment for collaboration days, with free breakfast in the office
  • Modern centrally located office, with gym onsite 
  • Internal training paths and support with external education
  • Diverse and dynamic environment, with plenty of opportunity to grow and make an impact 
  • Company benefits including discounts on famous brands

What You Can Expect From the Recruitment Process:

  • HR interview - AI fluency assessment (English)
  • Hiring Manager interview (French, Dutch)
  • Peer interview / skills assessment (French, Dutch)
  • C-level interview (English)

jobs.title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
jobs.description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (all genders)
jobs.description:
They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.
  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.
  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.
  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.
  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.
  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first
  • Obsessed with simplicity
  • First principles thinker
  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.
  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.
  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.
  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.
  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.
  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.
  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Phone Sales Agent - Restock
jobs.description:
Phone Sales Agent, Restock:

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out.

These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out.

  • Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence.

  • Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized.

  • Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine.

  • Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order.

  • Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion.

  • Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you.

  • Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis.

What You Bring to The Table:

  • Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results.

  • Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text.

  • Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records.

  • A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second.

  • A positive attitude and a passion for sales.

  • Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required.

Technical Must Have’s:

  • We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater (https://chromium.github.io/octane/).

  • A backup system for power and internet.

  • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day.

Compensation:

  • Base pay

  • 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue.

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance.

Schedule:

  • Full time (35-45 hrs per week)

  • Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT

  • Must be available to work weekends

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (Spain)

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.
